sloka: सर्वतः तुमुल आक्रन्दम् परिताप आर्त बान्धवम् ।सद्यो निपतित आनन्दम् दीन विक्लव दर्शनम् ॥२-६५-२८॥
transliteration: sarvataḥ tumula ākrandam paritāpa ārta bāndhavam ।sadyo nipatita ānandam dīna viklava darśanam ॥2-65-28॥

translations.english: On the demise of Dasaratha, joy instantly vanished. The palace was thronged with anxious people who were exceedingly bewildered and frightened. The royal family was anguished with distress. The palace was filled all over with the tumult of cries of agony. And it looked miserable with grief.
